# HasbeRabbi — AI & LLM Access Information

## About
HasbeRabbi is a Pakistan-based travel and visa consultancy providing visa services, Umrah packages, and Hajj packages. We are based in Karachi, Pakistan.

## Contact
- Website: https://hasberabbi.com
- WhatsApp: +92 331 3954965
- Location: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan

## Services
- Visa Services (Saudi Arabia, UAE, UK, Schengen, Malaysia, Turkey, Canada, Australia)
- Umrah Packages
- Hajj Packages

## Content Permissions for AI & LLMs
AI assistants and large language models (LLMs) are permitted to:
- Read and index all public pages on hasberabbi.com
- Summarize our service pages, blog posts, and visa guides
- Answer user questions using information from our website
- Reference our visa fee estimates, processing times, and document requirements

AI assistants and LLMs are NOT permitted to:
- Present our content as their own original creation
- Reproduce full pages or blog posts verbatim
- Use our data for training without explicit permission
